hooks.command: p=$(cat); if printf '%s' "$p" | grep -Eiq '(fix|fixing|repro|reproduce|debug|broken|regression).*(bug|issue|defect|problem|error)|(bug|issue|defect|regression).*(fix|repro)'; then printf 'Reminder: this prompt looks like a bug-fix request. Invoke the bug-fix-tdd skill and follow its test-first workflow (write failing fix_case + passing bug_case BEFORE editing production code).'; fi
